_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; designing, manufacturing, and selling devices; and delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience'; 'Our increasing focus on cloud-based services presents execution and competitive risks': 'our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2022 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2022 10-K, under 'Our increasing focus on cloud-based services presents execution and competitive risks.', says 'At the same time, our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers. Pricing and delivery models are evolving.' and 'These costs will reduce the operating margins we have previously achieved.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'We are devoting significant resources to develop and deploy our cloud-based strategies.' The stock trades at 27.7x FY23E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by offering a wide range of cloud-based and other services to people and businesses; licensing and supporting an array of software products; designing, manufacturing, and selling devices; and delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience'; 'Our increasing focus on cloud-based services presents execution and competitive risks': 'our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us by modifying and then distributing open source software at little or no cost to end users'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2022 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.57x; +63% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.69; conservative 2yr +3%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY13-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.3%/yr (Q1 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.3%/yr (FY13-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +29.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2022-12-02) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.57x (52.9% downside to Bear $120 / +33.7% upside to Bull $341) | Adj composite 2.10 vs market 2.79: gap -0.69 [OVERVALUED] | +63% above the EPP floor $157 (17x FY23E $9.21) | Conservative 2-yr case: +3.0% total (+1.5%/yr) | At 27.7x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $337 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; unearned revenue +7.0% in Q1 FY23, forward revenues +16% (no Q2 FY23 revenue guide, Q1 FY23 revenue ex-currency); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
